scenes.title: Previously on The Producers
scenes.summary: A brief recap revisits Seung-chan discovering Ye-jin and Joon-mo live under the same roof, taking a gulp of fish-sauce iced coffee, and beating Cindy at rock-paper-scissors.
scenes.location: KBS broadcasting centre and shooting site

scenes.title: Pink Captions and Lies
scenes.summary: While Seung-chan pitches Cindy's tent in the pouring rain, Cindy's manager asks him to edit the footage with lovely pink captions claiming Cindy built it herself, and Seung-chan refuses to lie.

scenes.title: Sleeping Outdoors in the Rain
scenes.summary: At base camp, Ji-yeon reports that Cindy carried her own bags up the steep hill to camp in the rain, and Joon-mo marvels that only clueless rookie Seung-chan could treat a top star that way.

scenes.title: Getting Cheer From a Friend
scenes.summary: For Cindy's final dinner chance, Seung-chan challenges her to hear words of encouragement from a close friend on the phone within one minute, resulting in an awkward failed call.

scenes.title: Please Edit Out That Phone Call
scenes.summary: Seung-chan leaves Cindy music, his bedtime book, and an emergency cap inside the tent, and Cindy quietly asks him to edit out the failed phone call so viewers will not think she is an outcast.

scenes.title: Speed Quiz With Her Producer
scenes.summary: Arriving at morning base camp, CEO Byun watches partnerless Cindy play the breakfast speed quiz with Seung-chan and miraculously guess outdoor sleeping from his encyclopedia-like clues.

scenes.title: It Is All for Ratings Too
scenes.summary: CEO Byun confronts Joon-mo over her agency's plummeting stock price; when Joon-mo snaps that people are not content, Byun fires back that starving Cindy in the rain is all for TV ratings too.

scenes.title: Too Tired Even to Scold
scenes.summary: Rattled by CEO Byun's words, Joon-mo chews Seung-chan out for letting Cindy go hungry all night in the rain and sighs that scolding the rookie already feels repetitive.

scenes.title: Changing Faith With Every Boss
scenes.summary: On Sunday at KBS, Tae-ho gossips with Ye-jin about the clash on the 2 Days & 1 Night set and admits he switched from Buddhist temple stays to church and Catholic Mass to match his bosses.

scenes.title: Starving Alongside the Guest
scenes.summary: Riding back from the shoot, a junior staffer tells Joon-mo that Seung-chan also skipped every meal for two days because Cindy could not eat.

scenes.title: Are You an Idol Too?
scenes.summary: During a Sunday Music Bank meeting, Ye-jin scolds her youngest writer for staying silent on ideas while texting top idols and dressing like a pop star, as Il-yong awkwardly praises her sociability.

scenes.title: Watch Your Mouth Tonight
scenes.summary: Ye-jin catches Seung-chan dropping off his bags before the 2 Days & 1 Night wrap dinner, reminds him he is under a drinking ban to protect her roommate secret, and asks where they are meeting.

scenes.title: Producers Hold the Knife Handle
scenes.summary: In her van, Cindy explains to her manager that producers shout 'Cut!' because editors hold the knife handle, insisting she must attend the team dinner to win favorable edits.

scenes.title: A Purely Accidental Family Dinner
scenes.summary: At the barbecue restaurant, Joon-mo spots Tae-ho's wife and Cindy-fan daughter at a nearby table while Tae-ho insists he bumped into them out front purely by chance.

scenes.title: I Did Not Recognize You Without Makeup
scenes.summary: Cindy fails to recognize bare-faced Ye-jin at the restaurant entrance; fuming inside, Ye-jin tells Joon-mo her team is writing apology statements before eagerly joining the 2 Days & 1 Night dinner.
scenes.location: Yeouido barbecue restaurant entrance and hall

scenes.title: She Only Scolds Female Idols
scenes.summary: Ye-jin nitpicks Cindy's expression at the dinner table while Joon-mo teases Ye-jin for only criticizing female idols, and Ye-jin beams when Seung-chan admits Cindy got cranky once on set.

scenes.title: Let's Clink Glasses and Forget Everything
scenes.summary: Ye-jin asks Joon-mo what to wear to her first Broadcast Standards hearing, then scrambles to change the subject with a beer toast when Cindy brings up rumors that Ye-jin scolded her.

scenes.title: Drinking Takes Mental Strength
scenes.summary: After boasting that mental strength keeps her sober, Ye-jin wanders into the wrong restroom, grabs Seung-chan over her housing secret, and unleashes extreme drunken cuteness on Joon-mo.

scenes.title: Can Make Him Fall Versus Will
scenes.summary: Riding home from the wrap dinner, Cindy's manager teases her that the Umbrella PD still has not fallen for her, and Cindy insists that 'can make him fall' and 'will' are completely different.

scenes.title: Once They See Our Seung-chan
scenes.summary: Watching Cindy on television at home, Jum-soon frets that female stars will fall head over heels for handsome Seung-chan while Bo-sun worries a scandal could ruin his election nomination.

scenes.title: You Are a Cruel Man
scenes.summary: Over live octopus at a street tent, tipsy Ye-jin calls Joon-mo cruel for going on blind dates after kissing her and confesses how hard it is to like the one friend she used to tell everything.
scenes.location: outdoor street snack tent at night

scenes.title: My Home Turned Into a Boarding House
scenes.summary: Waking up hungover, Ye-jin prays Joon-mo blacked out, then both are startled when Seung-chan emerges from the guest room and Joon-mo laments that his bachelor flat has become a boarding house.

scenes.title: Please Refrain From Staying Out Overnight
scenes.summary: Ye-jin's brother Ye-joon tries to matchmake his sister with Seung-chan over breakfast, and outside Seung-chan earnestly asks Ye-joon not to stay out overnight and leave Ye-jin alone with a man.

scenes.title: Is Paper Really Your Problem?
scenes.summary: Hungover Ye-jin wishes she could carve yesterday out of her life while a fellow producer complains bitterly that the admin desk refuses to issue A4 paper until his writers reuse scrap paper.

scenes.title: My Nickname Is Drunken Liar
scenes.summary: Summoning Seung-chan to the stairwell, Ye-jin insists her drunken habit is telling lies and winces when Seung-chan dutifully repeats every word of her street-tent speech.

scenes.title: A Special Mission
scenes.summary: Handing Seung-chan a drink as a gift, Ye-jin assigns him an undercover mission to find out whether Joon-mo blacked out as usual or sobered up in the cold night breeze at the street tent.

scenes.title: Seventy Thousand Won at the Street Tent
scenes.summary: Seung-chan brings Joon-mo red-ginseng water to test his memory; Joon-mo claims he blacked out completely and wonders how seventy thousand won was charged to his card at the street tent.

scenes.title: He Walked Home in Zigzags
scenes.summary: Seung-chan reports that Joon-mo forgot paying at the street tent, shocks Ye-jin with news that she paid for the entire barbecue dinner, and worries her by noting Joon-mo walked in zigzags.

scenes.title: Editing Is Never Finished, Only Stopped
scenes.summary: Joon-mo introduces Seung-chan to the windowless editing suite, Ji-yeon explains why the sun-starved staff buy vitamin D together, and Seung-chan reflects that editing is never finished, only stopped.

scenes.title: Passing Down the Barn Key
scenes.summary: A senior colleague hands Seung-chan the takeout menu binder like the key to a family barn, and when everyone orders from different shops, Joon-mo's black-bean noodles arrive soggy and swollen.

scenes.title: The Art of Ordering Editing-Room Meals
scenes.summary: Seung-chan consults an acclaimed rookie classmate on ordering editing-room meals: check menus before hunger turns to anger, avoid hundred-item shops, and spot kid palates by long sweet coffee orders.

scenes.title: Afraid of Being Edited Out
scenes.summary: On the rooftop, Seung-chan asks why Joon-mo must forget last night, and Ye-jin explains that in editing a remark with zero reaction gets cut—meaning Joon-mo may have edited out her feelings.

scenes.title: Sleepless With a Bedtime Book
scenes.summary: Exhausted between packed schedules, Cindy tells her manager she cannot fall asleep on command and opens the bedtime book Seung-chan lent her in the rain.

scenes.title: Four in the Morning in the Editing Booth
scenes.summary: At four in the morning in the editing booth, Joon-mo asks Seung-chan for a hilarious one-line caption and jokes he is a rival spy after hearing Seung-chan's stiff documentary-style titles.

scenes.title: A Variety Producer Must Give Up Everything
scenes.summary: Joon-mo vets Seung-chan's background to keep his funny reactions in the episode, and when Seung-chan asks to be edited out, Ji-yeon explains that variety producers give up all vanity for the show.
scenes.location: KBS editing booth and interview room

scenes.title: Nineteen Thousand Four Hundred Won
scenes.summary: Tae-ho angles for a guest cameo fee on 2 Days & 1 Night only to qualify for the modest staff rate, while a colleague tries in vain to rally a walkout against the supply desk over A4 paper.

scenes.title: Whoever Holds the Editing Machine Wins
scenes.summary: CEO Byun treats the entire variety department to pizza and asks In-pyo and Tae-ho to protect Cindy's edit, only for Tae-ho to admit that nowadays whoever holds the editing machine is king.

scenes.title: The First Thing She Ever Wanted to Do
scenes.summary: Visiting Joon-mo's editing booth, CEO Byun gets rebuffed when offering an envelope, then sincerely asks him to take care of Cindy because 2 Days & 1 Night is the first show Cindy ever asked to do.

scenes.title: That Street Tent Does Not Take Cards
scenes.summary: Sent to the street tent for snacks, Seung-chan discovers Joon-mo was sober and that the tent is cash-only, realizing Joon-mo remembered Ye-jin's confession all along.
scenes.location: outdoor street snack tent at night

scenes.title: Editing Means Giving Something Up
scenes.summary: In the epilogue, Tae-ho calls editing an arrow aimed at bosses' hearts, Ye-jin compares it to confident makeup, and Joon-mo defines editing as giving up what is good to keep what is better.
scenes.location: KBS interview room and Yeouido street
